newsitem.title: CHINA: China clarifies tax rules on foreign-funded firms.
newsitem.headline: China clarifies tax rules on foreign-funded firms.

text.p: China's State Administration of Taxation has ruled that incomes of subsidiaries of foreign- funded firms in China should be taxed according to the rate in the area where the subsidiaries are based, the Securities Daily said on Tuesday.

If a foreign-funded firm is based in an area in China that extends preferential tax rates and if its subsidiary is located outside that area, the subsidiary's income will be taxed according to the rate levied in the area where the subsidiary is based, the newspaper quoted the administration as saying.
The ruling applies to subsidiaries engaged in production, trading and the service industry, the newspaper said.
The administration also ruled that the income tax rate of the area where a foreign-funded firm manufactures its goods applies when taxing sales of goods outside the area, it said.
